description: Dacora于1953年推出的折叠相机。配备Subita 1:6.3/75mm Anastigmat, distances 1m to infinite。快门速度Singlo shutter with speeds 1/25 sec., 1/75 sec, and B, and with flash connector. Cocked on the long shifting travel of the release lever。使用type 120 film rolls。
